name: Furg Citadel
scope: The standing and ruined exterior of Furg Citadel on the ridge above Forg village, with the irregular outer curtain, round towers, west high compound and eastern entry.
era: The surviving visible ruin shown in Nima Baghaei’s early 2000s photograph, following historic repairs.

originalReview.notes: The exact Qualla original shows the tan earthen curtain above Forg, its heavier west round tower, eroded wall cap, narrow facing holes and upper broken tower. Wikimedia resolves the credited username to the account that uploaded the author’s public-domain file.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The published Qualla photograph is the native original of the same author's first and only upload, dedicated to the public domain. The two other public-domain files found in the Commons category crop that same original. Map and official architectural facts supply the wider plan.
